acceptance_criteria.condition: Triggered untrusted-input and sensitive-sink paths require source-to-control-to-sink evidence and a sink-specific control.
The detailed security-path reference, README summary, and default prompt remain synchronized with the normative Skill.
The updated skill package has valid frontmatter and no unfinished scaffolding.

invariants: Untrusted-input paths use controls specific to the eventual sink and keep authorization or policy enforcement at the server-side operation boundary.
Scanner findings remain leads until reachability, existing controls, and impact have been reviewed.
Minimal synthetic malicious inputs may appear only in local tests or fixtures and are not echoed into logs, reports, snapshots, or externally shared artifacts.

safeguards.name: source-to-sink tracing
safeguards.rationale: The gate requires source -> validation/normalization -> authorization or policy -> sink evidence only on relevant code paths.

safeguards.name: sink-specific framework controls
safeguards.rationale: The normative guidance rejects generic sanitizers and directs agents to parameterized, context-aware, allowlisted, schema-bound, or framework-native controls.

safeguards.name: safe adversarial test boundary
safeguards.rationale: The guidance permits minimal local synthetic inputs for rejection-path tests while prohibiting their disclosure in persistent output artifacts.

safeguards.name: finding verification
safeguards.rationale: Scanner alerts require reachability, control, and impact review before confirmation or documented exclusion.

design_boundary.rationale: SKILL.md owns the short trigger and required evidence; the linked reference owns category-specific controls, preserving progressive disclosure.

dependency_audit.rationale: The change adds no package, scanner, external service, or runtime dependency.

extension_decision.rationale: The focused reference is a conditional guidance extension, selected only when the secure code-path trigger applies.

data_ownership.rationale: This Skill-package update does not create or transfer runtime business-data ownership.

error_model.rationale: The change has no application runtime error path; it specifies review and verification behavior.

contract_evolution.rationale: The public Skill contract, README, metadata prompt, reference, and contract tests were updated together.

operational_budget.rationale: The security review is route-triggered and moves detailed material to a reference, avoiding universal scans or new tooling.

threat_boundary.rationale: The gate covers inputs flowing to queries, commands, templates, files, URL fetches, parsers, deserializers, and authorization decisions.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The policy, documentation, metadata, reference, tests, review, and evidence are retained as one bounded package change.

release_recovery.rationale: This package update has no production rollout; a single revert can remove the policy, reference, summaries, test, and evidence together.

data_migration.rationale: No persisted schema, data, or public data migration is changed.

configuration_secrets.rationale: The new policy explicitly prohibits real secrets and production payloads in test fixtures, logs, reports, snapshots, and external artifacts.

dependency_supply_chain.rationale: No dependency, lockfile, marketplace skill, or CI action changed.

operational_knowledge.rationale: The README, detailed reference, and metadata prompt explain when the gate applies and how a finding is dispositioned.

reproducibility.rationale: Focused test, package validation, compilation, and whitespace checks were captured with commands, timestamps, Git revision, and content hashes.

verification.result: 18 Skill contract tests, including the secure code-path contract, passed.
The skill package validator reported: Skill is valid!
All package scripts and tests compiled successfully.
No whitespace errors were reported for the tracked patch.

supporting_artifacts.summary: Focused contract-test output showing all 18 tests passed.
Independent final-diff review approving the scoped guidance change and recording its limits.

rollback_or_compatibility: Revert the Secure Code Path Gate, reference, README and metadata summaries, contract test, and evidence artifact together; no runtime compatibility path is introduced.

independent_review.notes: No medium- or high-severity finding remained after the fixture boundary and duplicate README-row corrections. The reviewer confirmed the change remains policy guidance, not a universal protection claim.

remaining_risks: The gate guides code generation and review but cannot enforce controls in a target repository unless that repository adopts and executes it.
No effectiveness experiment or application-level attack replay was run; this change makes no general claim that it prevents all attacks.
The final full suite had four failures and eight errors in pre-existing native-cleanup frozen-protocol hash checks outside this change's scope.
